BeeBot

menu
Is there a subscription or refill option?
While we do not offer automated recurring subscriptions, we make refilling and maintaining your bee house very easy.
Since nesting materials must be replaced or cleaned each season to keep your bees healthy, you can purchase replacement nesting refills—such as natural lakebed reeds, cardboard BeeTubes, or paper inserts—whenever you need them. You can also order new bee cocoons annually for each spring or summer season.
